problem_statement: The DNS TXT entry type needs a method that indicates whether the entry's key matches a given string using case-insensitive comparison, returning false when the key is null. Border agent TXT data processing and TREL peer discovery both need to compare parsed TXT entry keys against known key strings without requiring exact case. Without this method, callers must manually check for null keys and perform case-insensitive string matching inline, leading to repeated boilerplate and inconsistent handling of entries whose key exceeds the maximum recommended length (where the key is null and the full entry is placed in the value).
